title: Electronic Body Music
tagline: Machine rhythm turned into a physical, body-led pulse.
summary: Electronic body music builds on synthesizers, percussion and constant pulse to create a direct physical response. It often feels colder and more mechanical than dance-pop, but its aim is not distance: it is movement, pressure and a sense of being pulled forward. The style became central to club and post-industrial scenes in Europe.

pillars.name: Front 242
pillars.why: Front 242 made EBM feel disciplined and tense, with precise rhythm and strong low-end drive.

pillars.name: Nitzer Ebb
pillars.why: Nitzer Ebb brought a more hook-driven and danceable edge to the style without losing the weight.

pillars.name: The Neon Judgement
pillars.why: The Neon Judgement helped extend the sound into a more atmospheric, synth-heavy register.
